_pools_are_tods: ⚠️ READ THIS BEFORE INTERPRETING THE POOL FIELD. East Haddam, Griswold Club, NorthEast and REFS are TOD'S OWN POOLS in Central Assign. A referee 'in three pools' is not undiscovered talent - Tod already put them there. The two findings that actually matter are (1) people in Tod's pools who have NEVER LOGGED IN, i.e. he has them but cannot reach them, and (2) people living in client towns who are in NO pool at all.
